caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular design bordered with a repeating chain-like pattern in red, black, and gray, with additional decorative purple scrollwork in the corners. Within the border, an oval-shaped arrangement of various flowers and leaves is depicted, densely packed. The flowers are depicted in shades of red, pink, yellow, blue, and purple, with green leaves interspersed throughout. The flowers vary in shape and size, some with layered petals and others more rounded or pointed. Blue elements, possibly representing flowers or leaves, are also scattered among the red and yellow blossoms. The background is a muted off-white or beige. Near the bottom left corner, there are small handwritten markings, including the name "E. VALENTINE" and the number "14.6". The entire composition is rich in color and detail, with a focus on floral and botanical motifs.
title: Hooked Rug
